subject: Vendor onboarding: Solstice Shipping — Spanish tax residency + PO entity split
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: María López <m.lopez@solsticeshipping.es>, Solstice AP <ap@solsticeshipping.es>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: initial docs & PO entity question

Hi María / Solstice AP,

Thanks for agreeing to onboard with Redwood — excited to get Solstice Shipping in the system. A few items we need to complete procurement and ensure PO/invoice flow across our EU entities:

- Official Spanish tax residency evidence (certificate of fiscal residence) and the exact legal name & NIF (VAT number) to appear on the PO/invoice.
- Sample invoice that shows how you normally present VAT lines for B2B services in Spain (we need to validate reverse-charge vs VAT charged).
- Bank remittance details and the remit email for AP.
- Confirmation of the legal entity you want POs issued to (Solstice Shipping SL vs Solstice Maritime Group Ltd.) — Redwood sometimes needs POs split across legal entities for local VAT handling.

Attached is our PO template to show required fields (Redwood_PO_template.pdf). If you already have a supplier profile packet, please send that too. Once we have the residency cert and sample invoice we can tell you whether the invoice should be VAT 0 / "inversión del sujeto pasivo" or include VAT.

Can you send the cert and sample invoice by EOD Wednesday (5/6)? If any of this requires a fiscal representative, call that out and we'll follow procurement steps for fiscal-rep validation.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0192

From: María López <m.lopez@solsticeshipping.es>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Solstice AP <ap@solsticeshipping.es>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@solsticeshipping.es>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 10:34:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial docs & PO entity question

Hola Tessa,

Thanks — attached are the requested docs:
- Solstice_Certificado_Residencia_Fiscal.pdf (certificate of fiscal residence issued by Agencia Tributaria)
- Solstice_VAT_NIF.txt (NIF: ESB12345678)
- Sample_Invoice_Solstice_0001.pdf (sample invoice showing our usual service line items)

Quick context: Solstice Shipping operates in Spain under Solstice Shipping SL (ES branch). Parent company (Solstice Maritime Group Ltd.) is UK-based but billing for Spanish operations is typically in the Spanish entity. For digital/logistics services to EU customers the standard treatment is reverse-charge when customer is a taxable person in the EU. We will not charge Spanish VAT if you (Redwood) are a business customer with a valid VAT number and the invoice references "inversión del sujeto pasivo".

We are happy to accept POs addressed to Solstice Shipping SL. If you need any additional signature on the residency cert or a notarised copy, let me know — I can escalate with legal.

Also attaching the contact for AP (ap@solsticeshipping.es) and their bank details are in the sample invoice footer.

Best,
María
Operations Manager
Solstice Shipping SL

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial docs & PO entity question

Thanks for the docs — nice and clean. A few procurement/tax notes from my side:

- Given Solstice provided a Spanish fiscal residence certificate and NIF, we should set the onboarding entity to Solstice Shipping SL (Spain) for EU POs. That keeps invoicing local and avoids cross-border VAT complexity when services are performed/consumed in Spain.
- For our services where Redwood is billed for platform/hosting, reverse-charge is typically applicable (Spanish supplier issues invoice with VAT = 0 and includes the clause "inversión del sujeto pasivo" + our VAT). Finance will still want to see the supplier cert on file.
- Operational ask: create two PO numbers only if Solstice requests split billing across their UK parent for non-Spanish activities. Otherwise issue PO to the Spanish entity and tag it PO-RED-EU-ESP-#####.
- I'll attach a short internal note (VAT_reverse_charge_cheatsheet.pdf) to help AP and Finance reconcile entries.

Neha — can you start the supplier record with Solstice Shipping SL as the legal name and attach the residency cert? Also confirm whether we need an additional signed Supplier_Onboarding_Form_EU.docx from them (I think yes).

Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: VAT_reverse_charge_cheatsheet.pdf (pdf)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: María López <m.lopez@solsticeshipping.es>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial docs & PO entity question

Hi María,

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A quick checklist and next steps so we can close onboarding by Friday 5/8: 

1) Please sign the Supplier_Onboarding_Form_EU.docx and upload via the DocuSign link below (we need signature to create the legal supplier record). DocuSign: https://docusign.com/Signing/DocuSignID=ABC1234
2) Confirm the exact legal name for POs: "Solstice Shipping SL" and confirm billing address to be printed on the PO.
3) Confirm whether you require POs to be split between Solstice Shipping SL and the UK parent for any cost centers — if yes provide preferred allocation rules.
4) If you use a fiscal representative for VAT filings, please provide their name/contact and confirm whether invoices should include their reference.

Once signed, I will:
- Create a supplier record (legal name: Solstice Shipping SL)
- Attach the residency cert and sample invoice to the file
- Raise PO-RED-EU-ESP-000342 (example) and send draft PO to you for acceptance

If you can complete (1) + (2) by EOD Thursday 5/7 we should be able to issue the PO and complete the first payment window next week.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Vendor Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Supplier_Onboarding_Form_EU.docx (docx)]
